title: Viz fromText input
description: Render a governed chart from a FREE-TEXT request (sprint-132). A Claude parser running ABOVE the deterministic tool boundary maps the utterance + the data columns into the frozen s131 structured intent; that intent is routed through viz.render (which validates + renders deterministically) and echoed back (advisory) so the agent can re-run viz.render(intent) deterministically. The non-determinism is contained to the parse and measured by the nvBench-style accuracy gate.

text.description: The natural-language chart request (e.g. 'show the trend of export value over the years').

rows.description: Inline data rows — REQUIRED for v0.1. The parser reads the column names from these rows, and viz.render embeds data.values from them. Each row is a flat object mapping field name to value.

datasetRef.description: RESERVED (v0.1): rows-less / datasetRef-only requests are deferred — the parser needs inline rows to read the columns. Provide `rows`.

output.description: Optional render output controls, passed through to viz.render. Omitting this object preserves compact, Vega-Lite-only behavior.

compact.description: When true, omit the full token CSS from the response and return a tokenCssRef instead (use tokens.build to fetch it).

echarts.description: Opt in to ALSO compiling and returning an ECharts option (echartsSpec) alongside the default Vega-Lite spec.

includeNormalizedSpec.description: When true, also return the intermediate NormalizedVizSpec IR alongside the compiled renderer spec.

includeA11y.description: When true, also return a STRUCTURED two-part text alternative (accessible data table + narrative summary), and — when the parsed intent carries a governed measureRef — the governed narrative clause ('vs target …', 'unit …'). DEFAULT false keeps the wire compact.
